name: server
description: HTTP server with Express, static file serving, and Vite dev mode support

host.description: Host address to bind the server to

staticPath.description: Path to static files directory (auto-detected if not provided)

appAnalytics.description: Serve the App Analytics relay at POST /_analytics/v1/logs, which forwards browser OTLP log records (up to 64 KiB and 100 records per request) to the OTel Collector. Set to false to remove the route
